title: Embedding live documents via the Iframely protocol integrates Powerhouse into third-party tools
content:
Proposed at the Aug 14 weekly (00:25:08–00:32:23): implement document embedding the way Speckle embeds models into Notion.

Mechanism: the **Iframely protocol** provides metadata and standardized rules for embedding web content. A user copy-pastes a Powerhouse document URL into Notion, Miro, or SharePoint and gets a **live, interactive document editor** embedded in place.

Why it matters strategically: network-based organizations — the norm in construction — have different stakeholders on varied, entrenched systems. Embedding lets Powerhouse enter those workflows with almost no friction and supports organic growth, rather than demanding a platform switch. It converts every third-party wiki page or board into a potential Powerhouse surface.

Next step from the meeting: integrate iframe embedding capabilities into the Datab project demo.
description: Copy-paste a URL and get a live, interactive Powerhouse document inside Notion, Miro, or SharePoint. Low-friction adoption for network organizations with heterogeneous stacks.
